newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end flat in futures-boosted trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end flat in futures-boosted trade.

text.p: MADRID, Nov 15 (Reuter) 1630 GMT - Madrid stocks ended flat to a touch lower on Friday in busy futures-boosted trade, with corporate results providing the focus. * General index down 0.22 points, 0.06 percent, to 389.72 * Ibex-35 fell 3.01 points, 0.07 percent, to 4,489.90 * Telefonica dropped 30 pesetas to 2,760 after posting nine month results bang in line with analyst expectations, although dealers see the shares rebounding again amid thick demand. * Iberdrola ended up 5 pesetas to 1,445. The firm announced nine-month net profit up 20 percent, just after the close. * Index seen aiming for new highs next week.
Some electric utilities and motorways are still due to report their results to September.
Volume of 75.7 billion pesetas was bumped up by futures-related trade.
"The futures expiry has set the pace today, both in terms of turnover as well as in the price trend," said one trader.
Stocks may well make further headway next week, helped by Thursday's benign October inflation data and expectations of more cuts in the Bank of Spain's key money rate, dealers said.
